plan.summary: Zoho OAuth Adim 3 P3-B1 — Dashboard UI icin API katmani. Invekto.Integrations'a 4 yeni tenant-scoped endpoint (GET /api/v1/zoho/connection, DELETE /api/v1/zoho/connection, GET /api/v1/zoho/sync-log paginated+filtered, POST /api/v1/zoho/sync-log/{id}/retry). Invekto.Backend'e 6 proxy endpoint (connection GET/POST-connect-url/DELETE, stage-mappings GET read-only, sync-log GET+retry) /api/v1/zoho/* altinda tenant-JWT'den gelen tenant'i Integrations'a X-Internal-Service-Token ile forward eden IZohoProxyClient. Shared.Contracts.Zoho 3 yeni DTO (ZohoConnectionStatusDto, ZohoSyncLogEntryDto, ZohoSyncLogPageResponse). UI yok — P3-B2 ayri paket.
plan.q_intent: Q direktifi (2026-04-15 session prompt + interview): (1) Dashboard Zoho UI icin backend API katmani; (2) Transport = Backend proxy pattern (UI sadece Backend ile konusur, Integrations direkt cagrisi YOK); (3) Disconnect endpoint P3-B1'e dahil (zoho_connections.disconnected_at soft-delete + token revoke best-effort); (4) Sync log tablosu full filterable/paginated (status, zoho_event, date range + page/pageSize offset-based); (5) Manuel retry endpoint (POST /api/v1/zoho/sync-log/{id}/retry) — failed row'u 'pending'e set eder, attempt_count reset; arka plandaki RetryWorker bir sonraki tick'te pickup eder. UI katmani P3-B2 yeni session.
plan.interview_notes: Q kararlari: (a) Disconnect Integrations endpoint'i YENI eklenir (repository DisconnectAsync zaten var, endpoint yok). Zoho revoke /oauth/v2/token/revoke best-effort: hata durumunda DB soft-delete yine de yapilir, revoke hatasi log. (b) Sync log endpoint response = page + pageSize + totalCount + items[]. Filtre alanlari: status (pending/failed/success), zoho_event (string), from (ISO8601), to. (c) Retry endpoint: UPDATE zoho_sync_log SET status='pending', attempt_count=0, updated_at=NOW() WHERE tenant_id=@tid AND id=@id AND status='failed'; 0 row etkilenirse 404. (d) Backend proxy HTTP client IZohoProxyClient ZohoSyncClient pattern'ini mirrors — named HttpClient + InternalServices:SharedSecret + typed catches. (e) Stage mappings PUT Backend proxy'de DISARIDA tutuluyor (read-only P3-B'de); P4'te acilacak. (f) Connection status response: { connected: bool, region?, zohoUserEmail?, connectedAt?, lastRefreshedAt? }. (g) Pagination: pageSize default 20, max 100.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Invekto.Shared.Contracts.Zoho'ya 3 yeni DTO: ZohoConnectionStatusDto (Connected bool + optional Region/ZohoUserEmail/ConnectedAt/LastRefreshedAt), ZohoSyncLogEntryDto (Id/ZohoEvent/SourceLeadId/ZohoLeadId/Status/AttemptCount/LastErrorCode/LastErrorMessage/UpdatedAt/CompletedAt), ZohoSyncLogPageResponse (Items + Page + PageSize + TotalCount). PascalCase, init-only.

Invekto.Integrations: GET /api/v1/zoho/connection (tenant JWT, ZohoConnectionRepository.GetActiveAsync mapping). DELETE /api/v1/zoho/connection (tenant JWT, token revoke best-effort + DisconnectAsync + cache invalidate). GET /api/v1/zoho/sync-log (tenant JWT, page/pageSize/status/event/from/to filtre, max pageSize=100). POST /api/v1/zoho/sync-log/{id}/retry (tenant JWT, id int64, yalnizca status='failed' tenant-scoped row; status='pending' + attempt_count=0). Hepsi /api/v1/ prefix altinda = standart JwtAuth'tan gecer.

Invekto.Backend: IZohoProxyClient + ZohoProxyClient (named HttpClient BaseAddress=Integrations, X-Internal-Service-Token shared secret, typed catches HttpRequestException/TaskCanceledException/JsonException, null-return on failure, INV-INT-127 pattern). Yeni proxy endpoint'ler /api/v1/zoho/* (GET connection, POST connect-url [mevcut ZohoConnectionService mantigi Integrations'ta, proxy GET ile connect-url alir], DELETE connection, GET stage-mappings read-only, GET sync-log paginated+filter, POST sync-log/{id}/retry). TenantContext'ten tenant_id cozulur, Integrations'a forward'da body/query'de tenant yok — Integrations kendi JWT'sinden okur (JWT forward).

JWT forward pattern: Backend proxy Integrations'a cagri yaparken X-Internal-Service-Token DEGIL, tenant JWT'sini forward eder (Authorization: Bearer <orig>). Integrations /api/v1/ endpoint'leri zaten kendi JwtAuth middleware'i ile tenant_id'yi cikarir. Shared secret YALNIZCA /api/internal/zoho/sync icin (P2'de kullanilan). Bu P3-B1'de YENI PATTERN — onceki P2 shared-secret modelinden farkli, user-facing endpoint'ler tenant JWT'si ile. Alternatif: Backend proxy shared-secret + body.TenantId (P1/P2 modeli) — SECMEDIK cunku tenant JWT zaten UI'den geliyor, dogrudan forward daha az attack surface.

arch/errors.md yeni kodlar: INV-INT-128 (zoho_sync_log row not found on retry), INV-INT-129 (zoho_sync_log retry row not in 'failed' state), INV-INT-130 (Zoho token revoke best-effort failure, non-fatal — disconnect proceeds). ZohoErrorCodes mirror guncellenir.

Full solution build PASS. Mikroservis izolasyonu korunur (Backend -> Integrations SADECE HTTP, ProjectReference YOK). Dogrulama: `grep -rn 'using Invekto.Integrations' src/Invekto.Backend/` bos doner (veya sadece Shared contracts).

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: Backend proxy JWT forward pattern (Authorization: Bearer) — P2'deki shared-secret+body.TenantId modelinden FARKLI.
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: User-facing endpoint'ler UI'dan tenant JWT alir; dogrudan forward hem attack surface'i (tenant spoofing) dusurur hem de Integrations'taki mevcut JwtAuth middleware'ini tekrar kullanir. P2 shared-secret modeli internal Backend->Integrations lifecycle hook icin gecerli; burada UI->Backend->Integrations end-user trust chain var, farkli model uygun.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: Codex 'Backend proxy neden shared-secret kullanmiyor?' diye sorarsa: internal/zoho/sync P2'de shared-secret cunku caller Backend lifecycle (no user JWT); /api/v1/zoho/* burada UI->Backend->Integrations end-to-end tenant JWT, forward daha gevsek degil, AYNI JWT hem Backend'e hem Integrations'a authenticate ediyor.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: Retry endpoint attempt_count=0 reset eder, UI/yonetici bunu biliyor.
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: P2 RetryWorker 'attempt_count < 2' filtresi kullaniyor. Zaten 2 denemede failed olmus bir row tekrar denenmek istenirse attempt_count reset sart; aksi takdirde RetryWorker picked up etmez. Kullanici manuel 'Tekrar dene' dedigi icin niyet belli.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: Codex CQ6/CQ11 'attempt_count reset audit trail kaybi' diyebilir. Kabul: audit trail icin last_error_code/last_error_message degismiyor, sadece attempt_count ve status sifirlaniyor; kullanici niyeti + semantics tutarli.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: Zoho revoke endpoint'i best-effort (disconnect ana path'i rahatsiz etmez).
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Zoho's revoke endpoint bazen rate limit/network hatasi doner. Amac local state'i temizlemek (app tarafindan Zoho'ya istek gitmemesi); revoke basarisiz olsa bile disconnected_at set edildigi icin local state dogru. Revoke hatasi INV-INT-130 ile log.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: Codex CQ1/CQ10 'revoke failure silent' diyebilir. Kabul: INV-INT-130 log yazilir (SystemWarn), kullaniciya 200 donulur (DB disconnect basarili). Silent degil, observable.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: Backend proxy connect-url endpoint'i OAuth redirect'i UI yerine Backend'den yonlendirmez — sadece URL doner; UI window.location.href ile redirect eder.
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Standart OAuth2 flow: authorization code grant redirect browser yonetiminde. Backend/Integrations'in HTTP 302 dondurmesi de mumkun ama XHR/fetch ile calismaz; UI explicit redirect daha ongorulebilir.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: Codex Q5 'CSRF state validation' sorarsa: state HMAC-SHA256 + 10dk TTL ZohoOAuthStateService'de zaten yapiliyor (Adim 2 Paket A), /integrations/zoho/callback'te verify.

forbidden_areas: Zoho lifecycle davranis degisikligi (sadece yeni endpoint)
intentional_exclusions: Backend proxy endpoint'lerinin /api/ops/* altinda mount edilmesi (ops = cross-tenant, P3-B user-facing)

error_handling.silent_failure_explanation: Zoho revoke best-effort tek silent gorunumlu yol; INV-INT-130 SystemWarn ile log edilir, disconnect DB path garanti. Retry endpoint 404/409 ile user feedback.

user_facing_errors.when: POST retry id not found for tenant
Zoho revoke best-effort failure during disconnect

aha_moments.user_pain: Dashboard UI Integrations'a direkt CORS + double JWT gerektirir; 2 ayri domain icin CORS config maintenance yukanilir.
aha_moments.suggestion: Backend proxy pattern — UI sadece Backend ile konusur, CORS tek yerde, tenant JWT tek sefer dogrulanir (Integrations'ta).
aha_moments.aha_moment: Same-origin UI sadelesir; eklenecek her yeni Zoho endpoint'i ayni pattern'i izler (sabit cost).
